newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list Gulfstream Aerospace options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list Gulfstream Aerospace options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Friday it would list options on airplane designer and maker Gulfstream Aerospace Corp on January 17.
The exchange said the options would open with strike prices of 20, 22-1/2 and 25 and expirations in February, March, June and September.
On Friday, shares of the company ended down 1/4 at 22-5/8.
Spear, Leeds & Kellogg will be the specialist unit for the options, the AMEX said.
The CBOE also plans to list Gulfstream Aerospace options. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
